text: Bondarenko, Balaklava is ahead. We began by defending one city. Now we have a chance to finish freeing our land.
I remember the old hangar. How he was afraid to come out. Now I can barely keep up with him.
Two hundred and fifty targets ahead. Every aircraft type. The shortest gaps. This is the campaign’s final line. Save the celebrations.
We have always maintained that dragons do not exist. We will therefore be suspending our live commentary on current events.
At last, some quiet on the radio. One day I would like to hear the same quiet in the sky.
That is why you are flying. So people can come home and stop listening for sirens. We are waiting for both of you.
Understood. Well, my friend? One last sortie. Then home.
